in_marathi.name: Jainansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jainansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jainansh is derived from two Sanskrit words: 'Jaina' meaning 'victorious' and 'Ansh' meaning 'God's Grace'. This name is believed to bring divine blessings and success in life.
